# Audit — grilling
*Read-understand-gap @ ed37663 · 12 lines · 2026-07-28*

**What:** The discipline behind the grill family: relentless one-question-at-a-time interview until shared understanding; walks the decision tree, resolves dependencies between decisions in order; recommends an answer with each question; acts only after explicit confirmation.
**Key rule worth internalizing:** *facts* are looked up in the environment, *decisions* are always put to the user — a crisp autonomy boundary.
**Invocation:** model-invoked (no disable flag) — fires on "grill" phrases. **Dependencies:** none (pure method). Consumed by: grill-me, grill-with-docs, triage §4, wayfinder, improve-codebase-architecture §3.
**Security:** clean. **Gaps:** none — deliberately minimal; the family's variants (docs, batch) live elsewhere.
**Audit outcome:** clean; no complement material.
